events.title: Goseokjeong Autumn Flower Festival
events.source_note: SEASON-LEVEL, NOT EXACT DATES. Cheorwon county tourism describes the Goseokjeong Flower Garden autumn season as running early September to late October (cockscomb, zinnia, pink muhly; closed Tuesdays), bloom-dependent and adjustable by weather — so Sep 1-Oct 31 is a season approximation, not an announced festival window. Corrected pointreach-events-0728 verify — an earlier draft showed Aug 25-Nov 1 and quoted "late August to early November 2026" as if from the source; that phrase appears nowhere on the cited page, which named neither Cheorwon nor any dates.
